notes: Every word in the source secret list has an explicit wordThemes entry.
Words can belong to multiple themes.
Flavor themes are hand-curated for themed encounters; utility themes provide broad lexical coverage.
Always intersect a theme pool with the current allowed secret list after future word-list changes.
General is reserved for words without a confident specialized or lexical theme.
The updater assigns future uncategorized secrets to the utility-only general category; the game reports No category until a flavor category is curated.
